newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota to take major share in Indian car venture.
newsitem.headline: Toyota to take major share in Indian car venture.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp will take a stake of over 50 percent in a planned joint venture in India, company director Hideaki Otaka said on Wednesday.
Toyota is in talks with the Kirloskar group in India to form a joint venture car plant in a location still to be decided, he told Reuters.
Otaka said no other details were available, including the size of the investment. But he said the types of cars to be manufactured are likely to be multi-purpose or sport utility vehicles.
He said the companies hope to announce the final plan for the joint venture in the middle of this year.
Currently, Suzuki Motor Corp has over 70 percent of the passenger car market in that country.
